scope.rejected_experiment: A general bivariate linear-combination rewrite for cardinal nonzero-translation incidence was measured and reverted because it increased cycles and branch misses in the established cardinal re-offset lane despite a small instruction reduction.

exactness.identity: For Q=C+s(P-C)+T, expanding |Q-C|^2-r^2 and substituting the already-certified selected-root identity |P-C|^2=r0^2 gives the implemented expression exactly.
exactness.homogeneous_form: The rational component is D^2*(s^2*r0^2+|T|^2-r^2)+2*s*D*T dot rational(P-C); the radical component is 2*s*D*T dot radical(P-C). D is the retained positive common denominator.
exactness.coefficients: Every coefficient remains hyperreal::Real and all construction uses exact Real arithmetic; no finite preview or approximate coordinate enters the predicate.
exactness.policy: The scalar fast path calls the shared policy-aware Real sign operation. The oblique path terminates in the existing selected-root trivariate radical sign predicate, so APPROXIMATE_512 remains only the final equality fallback when exact proof is unavailable.
exactness.failure_semantics: Tensor-cap exhaustion still returns Unsupported/Uncertain through the existing classification path; the optimization introduces no guessed mathematical result.

benchmark_method.wall_primary: Nine alternating process pairs, one Runner sample per process and eight timed operations after the untimed warm-up.
benchmark_method.wall_final_sanity: One pinned process per executable, seven calibrated 100 ms samples after the untimed warm-up.
benchmark_method.perf: perf stat -r 5, 32 timed operations plus one warm-up; subtract the implementation-filter=disabled process and divide by 33.
benchmark_method.heap: Heaptrack record-only, 32 timed operations plus one warm-up; subtract the disabled process and divide by 33.
benchmark_method.size: GNU size and stat on the all-feature comparative executables.

wall_performance.interpretation: Wall time remains neutral within process and host noise; no throughput win or regression is claimed.

deterministic_perf.interpretation: The exact lane retires 0.12% fewer instructions and 0.27% fewer branches. Cycles are effectively neutral; branch-miss and cache-miss deltas are too noisy to claim.

allocation_evidence.interpretation: The identity avoids 257 heap allocation calls per Boolean-plus-re-offset operation; heaptrack temporary-allocation counts were materially unchanged.

linked_size.interpretation: The linked file and text shrink slightly; the 12-byte allocated-section increase is negligible and is reported rather than characterized as a size win.

verification.all_features_clippy: cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings: passed for Hypercurve; only the pre-existing Hypertri dependency dead-code warning was emitted
